profile.headline: Software Engineer II | C#/.NET | ASP.NET | EF | AI Workflow Automation | Performance Optimization
profile.summary:
I’m a Software Engineer II with 6+ years of professional experience, focused on building scalable .NET applications, improving system performance, and developing AI-assisted tools for real business workflows.

My strongest areas are C#, .NET, ASP.NET, Entity Framework, SQL Server, API development, backend optimization, Azure DevOps, and production web systems.

At GoEngineer, I work primarily with .NET 8, ASP.NET, Entity Framework, and SQL Server across high-traffic web applications. My recent work has included optimizing API endpoints, reducing database calls, improving page load performance, increasing Lighthouse scores, implementing structured data across thousands of CMS pages, and supporting CI/CD deployments through Azure DevOps pipelines.

Recently, much of my work has focused on practical AI applications inside business systems. I’ve helped build AI-assisted CMS tooling, LLM-powered content workflows, internal chatbot experiences, and human-in-the-loop automation that helps teams improve documentation, route questions, and reduce repetitive manual work.

While I have experience across Angular, React, React Native, Node.js, PHP, Unity, and multiplayer networking, my strongest focus today is backend and full-stack .NET engineering.

Outside of software, I enjoy taking on difficult challenges. In 2018, I completed a thru-hike of the Appalachian Trail, walking 2,200 miles from Georgia to Maine over six months. That experience shaped how I approach engineering: stay adaptable, solve problems one step at a time, and keep moving forward when the path gets difficult.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
• Build and maintain full-stack applications using .NET, C#, ASP.NET, Entity Framework, and SQL Server, delivering scalable, high-performance web experiences.
• Develop AI-assisted internal tools and workflow automation systems using LLMs, including CMS content generation, AI-assisted CMS logic workflows with human review, internal chatbot experiences, documentation improvement loops, and operational processes that improve efficiency across business teams.
• Drove major site-wide performance improvements, increasing Lighthouse scores from ~25 to ~90 through backend optimizations, reduced database calls, and frontend tuning.
• Added Azure Profiler support and used performance diagnostics to resolve sustained production CPU utilization issues, reducing server CPU usage from ~70–80% with spikes up to 100% down to steady usage in the teens and low 20s.
• Optimized critical API endpoints, reducing average response times by up to 80% and significantly improving p95 latency across high-traffic routes.
• Implemented dynamic Schema.org structured data across 3,000+ CMS pages, improving SEO visibility and enabling richer search engine results.
• Identified and eliminated unnecessary database queries, memory pressure, and application bottlenecks, improving overall page load speeds by ~28% and up to 80% on key endpoints.
• Collaborate in an Azure DevOps environment using PR reviews, task boards, Agile sprint workflows, and CI/CD pipelines across development, staging, and production environments.
• Monitor and troubleshoot production systems via Azure Portal, Azure Profiler, logs, and performance metrics to proactively resolve issues and improve reliability.
positions.insights: Skills: ASP.NET · .NET Framework · Microsoft SQL Server · Large Language Models (LLM) · C#
